## What's new

A change to how this project releases, with no change to the application itself.

### Changed

- **Releases to the stable channel now happen only when the maintainer asks for
  them.** Work continues to land on the dev channel as it always has, but a
  stable release — the one production installations receive — is no longer cut
  automatically alongside it. The two channels are expected to sit apart, often
  by several releases, so that changes can be tested on dev before they reach
  production.

This release contains no application code changes.
